title: Dai et al. (2006) Extended Finnis-Sinclair parameters for Ag-W
citation: X. D. Dai, Y. Kong, J. H. Li, B. X. Liu, Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter 18 (2006) 4527-4542.

functional_form.pair_term: V(r) = (r-c)^2 * (c0 + c1*r + c2*r^2 + c3*r^3 + c4*r^4), for r <= c; 0 otherwise
functional_form.density_term: phi(r) = (r-d)^2 + B^2*(r-d)^4, for r <= d; 0 otherwise

parameter_units.A: eV^0.5 Angstrom^-1 (as tabulated in the paper's A parameter header: eV Angstrom^-1)

paper_benchmarks.warning: Dai et al. report a ~21.8% high melting-point prediction for W. This EFS set is a candidate for validation, not automatically a production-quality high-temperature Ag-W model.

usage_status: Literature parameters transcribed for reproducibility. No LAMMPS Ag-W .eam.fs file has been generated or validated from this parameter set yet.
